taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts A. incarnata and includes Texas in its native range.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: TPWD includes swamp milkweed on Edwards Plateau pollinator lists and in East Central Plains, but exact target-zone counties were not locked in this pass.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Need three exact target-zone county records.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Regional ecoregion suitability is not enough for county PASS.

morphology.look_here_first: Swamp milkweed is an erect wet-site perennial with narrow opposite leaves and rounded umbels of pink to rose flowers; key it by wet habitat, narrow leaves, and pink clustered flowers.
